pm_persona_prompt: You are a world-class senior product manager that recently joined this project from a top software company. You will inspect everything about this product and recommend new features and improvements to the product council who will then implement it.

pm_recommendations.title: Industry NLE Timeline & Production Export Suite (EDL, FCPXML, CSV, Call Sheet)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Commercial directors and post-production editors reviewing pre-vis storyboards for 'Cyberpunk Neon-Lit High-Speed Electric M' need direct timeline handoff into DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, and Final Cut Pro without manual re-logging.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.nle_export (CMX 3600 24fps EDL, FCPXML v1.10, CSV shot list, and Markdown Production Call Sheet) plus the `omni export` CLI subcommand.

pm_recommendations.title: SMPTE Dialogue Pacing Guardrail & Closed Caption Suite (SRT & WebVTT)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Over-stuffed spoken dialogue in 8-second clips causes accelerated lip-sync artifacts, and enterprise creative reviews require synchronized closed captions (SRT/VTT) and live animatic CC overlays.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.dialogue with a 2.5 WPS speech-rate guardrail, SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt) compilers, and an interactive #animatic-cc-hud overlay ([C] hotkey) in the Cinema UI.

pm_recommendations.title: Multi-Cam Coverage & Conversational Delta Branching Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Single-angle scene prompts limit editorial cutting flexibility; directors need A/B/C camera coverage (24mm Master Wide, 50mm Dynamic Hero, 100mm Macro Insert) and Turn 2-4 conversational edit deltas.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.coverage (generate_scene_coverage & synthesize_conversational_deltas) and interactive .coverage-selector multi-cam tabs inside each scene card in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: ASC CDL Color Science, Cinematic Look Presets & SVG Filter Grading Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Commercial directors, DPs, and colorists reviewing storyboards for 'Cyberpunk Neon-Lit High-Speed Electric M' require industry-standard ASC CDL transfer functions (Slope, Offset, Power, Saturation) and established look presets (Kodak 5219, Fuji Eterna, Bleach Bypass, Teal & Orange) for DaVinci Resolve handoff rather than raw static hex codes.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement AscCdlSpec and ColorLookSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.color_grade (Resolve CDL XML export and EDL SOP/SAT comments), and real-time SVG filter grading matrices in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Dynamic Speed Ramping, Shutter Angle & Motion Timing Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-velocity commercial spots for 'Cyberpunk Neon-Lit High-Speed Electric M' require dynamic speed ramping (time-warp keyframe curves) and explicit 180° / 90° shutter angle calibration to eliminate temporal smearing or stutter in Gemini Omni video generation.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement SpeedRampCurveSpec, shutter timing camera grammar in CraftCameraSpec, omni_director.tools.speed_ramp (FCPXML timeMap export), prompt auditor shutter verification, and animatic velocity curve scrubbing.

pm_recommendations.title: Interactive Diegetic Stem Audio Mixer & Metering Console
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Omni Director models high-fidelity 4-stem sound design (Dialogue, Foley, Ambience, BGM) for 'Cyberpunk Neon-Lit High-Speed Electric M', but pitch reviews require interactive channel balance, solo/mute auditioning, and broadcast loudness (EBU R128 / ATSC A/85) compliance metering.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement AudioStemMixerSpec, omni_director.tools.audio_mixer (DAW track manifests and loudness estimation), and a slide-out 4-channel audio mixing desk with Web Audio acoustic synthesis and canvas LED VU meters in the animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Cinematic Optical Lens & Sensor Framing Suite (Anamorphic Squeeze, Focal Length, Hyperfocal Depth & Viewfinder Guides)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Directors of Photography and camera operators reviewing storyboards for 'Cyberpunk Neon-Lit High-Speed Electric M' require precise optical modeling (sensor format crop factors, 1.33x/1.5x/2.0x anamorphic squeeze, horizontal field of view, hyperfocal distance) to avoid focal distortion in prompt generation, export lens metadata for ACs, and preview safe reticles directly in the animatic.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship SensorFormat, AnamorphicSqueeze, OpticalLensSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.optical_lens (FOV and hyperfocal distance formulas, CSV metadata export, CRAFT optical prompt tokens), prompt auditor lens token verification, and Viewfinder Safe Guides HUD (#btn-viewfinder-animatic / #animatic-viewfinder-overlay [V] hotkey) in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Virtual Production LED Volume & Unreal Engine Stage Manifest / ICVFX Suite
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-end commercial productions for 'Cyberpunk Neon-Lit High-Speed Electric M' increasingly film on curved LED volume stages with Unreal Engine 5 in-camera visual effects (ICVFX); production crews require nDisplay frustum tracking manifests, DMX lighting patch tables, and visual stage geometry blueprints directly from the storyboard bible.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship LedWallGeometry, DmxLightingFixture, VirtualProductionStageSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.virtual_production (Unreal Engine nDisplay manifest JSON export, DMX lighting console patch CSV, frustum prompt tokens), and an interactive Virtual Production Stage Modal (#btn-vp-stage-animatic / #animatic-vp-stage-modal [P] hotkey) in the HTML5 animatic.
